title: 再放大一點
subject: a designer on the seventeenth revision of a hotpot restaurant's menu at eleven at night, and the owner asking for the shop name to be bigger again
caption: Mandarin metalcore in the current Chinese scene style. A clean arpeggiated guitar intro; drop-C tuned guitars playing palm-muted chug breakdowns locked to a triggered kick; twin harmonized melodic lead guitars over the choruses; a growling bass doubling the riffs; drums with double-kick runs, a short blast section and half-time breakdowns hit with a china cymbal. Tight, heavy and modern, the guitars wide, the kick and the voice forward, almost no room. Male voice, screamed and growled harsh vocals in the verses and breakdowns, a clean sung tenor melody in the choruses. 168 BPM with half-time breakdowns, C minor. Sleepless fury at eleven at night, played dead straight. No hardcore punk two-step, no pop-punk skate beat, no rap verse, no synth pads, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, clean arpeggiated guitar, then the full band crashes in]

[Verse 1 - screamed]
晚上十一點 辦公室只剩我跟印表機
重慶火鍋店的菜單 第十七版
老闆在群裡 丟了一段六十秒的語音
我點開 他說 店名再放大一點

[Pre-Chorus - half-time, screamed]
已經比毛肚還大了
已經比整個鴛鴦鍋還大了

[Chorus - clean]
再放大一點
整張菜單 都快只剩下你的店名
再放大一點
蝦滑跟鴨腸 都被我擠到背面去了

[Verse 2 - screamed]
第十八版 他說太大了 有點土
第十九版 他說 還是第三版好看
第三版 早就被我刪了 那天凌晨兩點
回收站 是我親手清空的

[Breakdown - half-time chug, china cymbal, screamed]
第三版 第三版
誰還記得第三版

[Chorus - clean, harmonized leads above]
再放大一點
我把第一版打開 一個字都沒改 傳過去
再放大一點
他說 對 就是這個感覺

[Outro - clean arpeggiated guitar alone]
早上九點 菜單印出來了
他說 店名好像 有點太大了
